Basic
Absolute

Superpower Absorption

Various Superpower Stealers.

Power/Ability to:

Steal/absorb supernatural powers from others.
"I take power from the underserving. It's kinda my thing."
― Agatha Harkness after absorbing a small portion of Wanda Maximoff/Scarlet Witch's Chaos Magic (Marvel Cinematic Universe)
"Woah. What a rush. How do you do it kid? Even Superman never recharged this fast."
― Rudolph "Rudy" Jones/Parasite after absorbing Superboy's powers. (Young Justice)

The power to absorb or steal powers from others. Sub-power of Superpower Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. Not to be confused with Superpower Replication. Opposite of Power Bestowal.

Also Called[]

  • Power Assimilation/Consumption
  • Power Drain/Draining
  • Power Sapping/Siphoning
  • Power Stealing/Stripping/Theft

Capabilities[]

Users can absorb powers; assimilating supernatural abilities and powers directly from others even straight from the source, removing into themselves and utilize it in various ways, enhancing themselves with each new power drain expanding their arsenal of abilities and removing an opponent’s power. User can even stack several powers together, which may lead to Power Mixture and can augment them to higher levels or highest levels than the original user. The user could also technically make or mimic the effects of other powers that they may not yet possess themselves through this method.

Applications[]

  • Ability Information Archiving
  • Energy Absorption/Energy Drain
  • Peak Human/Enhanced/Supernatural Condition
  • Intuitive Absorption
  • Power Erasure
    • Power Destruction
  • Power Negation/Reduction
  • Power Containment
    • Self-Power Augmentation only when absorbing the same power or ability.
    • Self-Power Bestowal by transferring the absorb power into themselves.
  • Multi-Power Use
  • Power Mixture by combining absorbed powers.

Limitations[]

  • May not be able to absorb technology-based abilities, only to steal the power to manipulate it, unless they have Technological Assimilation or Property Absorption.
  • Cannot absorb Absolute Immortality, Absolute Regeneration, Meta Resurrection, Omnipotence and Omnilock.
  • Despite the powers being absorbed from other opponents, the powers will still have every single limitation that the abilities would possibly possess, for example, Fire Manipulation is useless against Fire Immunity.
  • User cannot absorb powers that are linked to basic anatomy.
    • Or, if they do, Body Horror may result.
  • Cannot absorb any power from those with Power Absorption Immunity, Power Anchoring or Singularity.
    • Offensive Immunity/Unknown Power
  • Unlike what Power Replication is capable of during supportive combat, the user's power cannot work as a supportive ability in of itself when forced to rob their own friends' abilities, unless they also have the power to transfer them back to them.
  • Does not work against Absorption Immunity, Absorption Negation, Flawless Indestructibility and Meta Power Immunity
  • Adaptive Abilities like Reactive Adaptation or Superior Adaptation could possibly become resistant / immune to the user's power.
  • May be permanent on the target and/or User.
  • May be unable to either discard or transfer the powers.
  • May be constantly active unless willed too not to be.
  • May have limited range, including touch only.
  • May be need see the activation of the power.
  • May need to fulfill certain requirements in order to absorb a power.
  • May not be able to choose what powers they can absorb from their opponents. In short, the power in question will be quite unruly as it'll just simply absorb every single power possible that the opponent or ally has.
  • There may be a limit on the number of capacities that can be acquired.
  • Power may no longer be usable if the original user of the absorbed power dies.
  • Users of Indomitable Will may be resistant.
  • Absorbing too much power may be fatal if the user's body normally is not as strong as the target.
  • Physical powers, like Multiple Arms and Multiple Eyes, may be painful to absorb.
  • May be unable to evolve/improve the power as the original user can, unless they also have Enhanced Power Absorption.
  • If the user becomes incapacitated or annihilated, the absorbed powers may return to the previous owners.

Notes[]

  • Energy Absorption: is similar in nature that both powers are used to transfer an entity's power to another entity. The difference is that energy absorption only transfers the energy (which the receiving person can use against their enemies with their own powers), while power absorption transfers an actual arsenal of powers (the receiving person is granted the powers of the first person and can use powers they may not have otherwise).
